extensions_directory.description: Directory where EDS extension modules (.so files) are installed.

enable_tasks.description: Enable tasks (iCalendar VTODO) support in EDS.

enable_memo.description: Enable memos (iCalendar VJOURNAL) support in EDS.

enable_mail.description: Enable mail (IMAP/POP/Local) support — *not* used by EDS daemon (keep false).

enable_offline.description: Enable offline mode: cache remote accounts locally for disconnected access.

max_connections_per_client.description: Maximum number of simultaneous connections allowed per client.

idle_connection_timeout.description: Seconds of inactivity before closing idle connections (0 = no timeout).

cache_path.description: Path to the SQLite database used for offline caching (used only if offline mode is enabled).

extensions.description: List of EDS extension modules to load at startup (by basename, e.g., 'caldav').

name.description: Human-readable name of the data source.

caldav_url.description: Base CalDAV URL for calendar (only for CalDAV sources).

carddav_url.description: Base CardDAV URL for address book (only for CardDAV sources).

ssl_trust_file.description: Path to CA trust store (e.g., '/etc/ssl/certs/ca-certificates.crt') for TLS verification.

oauth2_client_id.description: OAuth2 client ID (for OAuth2-backed CalDAV/CardDAV servers).
